6.76 rsInvalidSortExpressionScope
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
rsInvalidSortExpressionScope is a critical error that occurs if a UserSort.SortExpressionScope is set to
a detail scope.
